title: Mechanism of dihydroartemisinin in the treatment of ischaemia/reperfusion-induced acute kidney injury via network pharmacology, molecular dynamics simulation and experiments.
authors: Jiang, Beibei; Liu, Jiahui; Qu, Ziyi; Wang, Yanqing; Wang, Yuzhi; Li, Zhongtang; Jin, Xiaoming; Lao, Yunlan; He, Riming; Yang, Shudong
one_liner_zh: 该文研究双氢青蒿素治疗缺血再灌注急性肾损伤，涉及分子对接与MD模拟但对象为小分子-蛋白（NQO1），非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: To investigate whether dihydroartemisinin (DHA) attenuates ischaemia-reperfusion injury (IRI)-induced acute kidney injury (AKI) in mice by inhibiting oxidative stress and inflammation and to explore its potential molecular mechanisms. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Network pharmacology analysis was used to screen relevant targets, and molecular docking of DHA with core targets was performed. Molecular dynamics simulation of the target with the lowest binding free energy, NQO1-DHA.The renal protective effect of DHA on the IRI-induced AKI mouse model was evaluated. The expression levels of NQO1, Nrf2 and other proteins were detected by Western blotting. The expression levels of Nrf2 and others were detected by immunohistochemistry (IHC) and immunofluorescence (IF). RESULTS: Through network pharmacological analysis, we obtained that PI3K/AKT and MAPK signaling pathway may be related to DHA in the treatment of AKI.Molecular dynamics simulation indicated that NQO1 is an important target protein for DHA to exert nephroprotective effects.Moreover, the potential molecular mechanisms were verified by experiments.DHA reduced the serum creatinine (Scr) and urea nitrogen (BUN) levels in AKI mice, significantly improved AKI pathology, alleviated oxidative stress and inflammatory injury, which may be related to its activation of the Nrf2 pathway and regulation of macrophage polarization. CONCLUSIONS: Through network pharmacology, molecular dynamics simulation and experimental validation, we initially investigated that DHA alleviate AKI by ameliorating oxidative stress and inflammatory damage, which may be related to its activation of the Nrf2 pathway and the regulation of macrophage polarisation, which lays the foundation for subsequent in-depth study of the specific mechanism of action.
abstract_zh: 目的：探讨双氢青蒿素（DHA）是否通过抑制氧化应激和炎症减轻小鼠缺血再灌注损伤（IRI）诱导的急性肾损伤（AKI），并探索其潜在分子机制。材料与方法：采用网络药理学分析筛选相关靶点，并对DHA与核心靶点进行分子对接。对结合自由能最低的靶点NQO1-DHA进行分子动力学模拟。评估DHA对IRI诱导的AKI小鼠模型的肾脏保护作用。通过Western blotting检测NQO1、Nrf2等蛋白的表达水平。通过免疫组织化学（IHC）和免疫荧光（IF）检测Nrf2等的表达水平。结果：通过网络药理学分析，我们获得PI3K/AKT和MAPK信号通路可能与DHA治疗AKI相关。分子动力学模拟表明NQO1是DHA发挥肾脏保护作用的重要靶蛋白。此外，通过实验验证了潜在的分子机制。DHA降低了AKI小鼠血清肌酐（Scr）和尿素氮（BUN）水平，显著改善了AKI病理，减轻了氧化应激和炎症损伤，这可能与其激活Nrf2通路和调节巨噬细胞极化有关。结论：通过网络药理学、分子动力学模拟和实验验证，我们初步研究了DHA通过改善氧化应激和炎症损伤减轻AKI，这可能与其激活Nrf2通路和调节巨噬细胞极化有关，这为后续深入研究其具体作用机制奠定了基础。
